features: Up to 50 hrs of Playback: Amp your audio routine with the boAt Airdopes Plus 311 TWS Earbuds. From movies and music to podcasts, these earbuds make audio fun and effortless with their 50 hours of playtime.
Dual Mics with ENx Technology: With a set of 2 ENx-powered mics in total, these earbuds eliminate surrounding sounds for clear calls when you are on the go or attending calls in a busy workspace.
ASAP Charge: Juice up your Airdopes for 10 minutes and continue binge-watching for a massive 150 minutes thanks to ASAP Charge.
boAt Signature Sound: Disconnect from the chaos as you sing along to music powered by the bass-rich boAt Signature Sound from the 10 mm drivers of these earbuds.
Insta Wake N’ Pair (IWP): Unlock instant connectivity with IWP. Simply open the case lid and connect to the audio seamlessly.
